versions.changelog:
- Skill renamed from "yoga" to "todo" and fully repurposed for task management.
- Description, features, usage instructions, and examples updated to focus on todo list creation, updating, deleting, prioritizing, categorizing, and tracking tasks.
- Added a detailed task schema outlining all supported task fields.
- Tags changed for improved discoverability in the productivity and organization category.

- Initial release of the Yoga skill.
- Provides step-by-step guidance for over 50 yoga poses (asanas).
- Includes guided breathing (pranayama) and meditation sessions.
- Offers daily routines for various needs (energy, relaxation, stress relief).
- Features progress tracking for practice duration, pose mastery, and streaks.
- Simple commands for pose instructions, breathing, meditation, routines, and progress.
